applies_why: The judge text makes lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of single-verse non-statement K-S2 governs.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: The phrase "without explicit textual resolution of paternity" could mean (1) the verse or cited verses do not explicitly state a resolution, which K-S2 forbids as a ground, or (2) the chain genuinely leaves the issue open despite both senses standing; the judge appears to use reading (1).
why: The judge assigns UNDERDETERMINED because Romans 1:3's descent according to the flesh is not explicitly resolved against Holy Ghost conception, treating a verse's non-explicit resolution as decisive, contrary to K-S2.
